# Release Notes

<!-- Generated by tools/build_plugins.py -->

## 0.4.0 - 2026-11-25

- Replaced the dead meta sources with a verified registry: official Pokemon HOME regulation and eligible roster, Championship Series calendar and results, infovgc, LabMaus, Limitless, PokeStats, Smogon, Pikalytics, PokeBase, Pokepaste, PokeData, and Victory Road.
- Retired ChampionsMeta (HTTP 402, DEPLOYMENT_DISABLED) and removed ChampionsLab from the automated stack.
- Added a TLS-aware LabMaus fetcher that bundles the Sectigo DV R36 intermediate, verifies the chain and hostname, pins the certificate fingerprint, and sends the required Origin and Referer headers.
- Added a deterministic live-source probe with offline registry coverage, JSON and Markdown output, and retired-source checks.
- Added current/upcoming/historical regulation states, a deterministic regulation resolver, and a stable current-regulation reference so M-D preparation does not require editing every skill wrapper.
- Recorded the announced M-D transition: December 2, 2026 through March 3, 2027, with Heatran, Dondozo, Tatsugiri, Mega Heatran, and Mega Tatsugiri named by the official page. M-D remains upcoming until the official start.
- Reworked vgc-team-builder around meta snapshots with explicit fallbacks, real core grounding, a legality ledger, capped benchmarks, a synergy audit, and an export gate.
- Translated and restructured the README, added source, team-building, installation, and validation guides, and documented OpenCode V1, V2, desktop, and web installs.
